def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    n_steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (n_steps - 1)

    # Initialize points array: (n_runs, n_steps, 3)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, n_steps, 3), dtype=np.float64)

    # fill all with start lat, lon and time=0 at step 0
    lat0 = np.full(n_runs, start[0], dtype=np.float64)
    lon0 = np.full(n_runs, start[1], dtype=np.float64)
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat0
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon0
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0

    # Hypothesis: staying_put = no movement, just remain at start lat/lon for all times
    # Set time non-decreasing
    for i in range(1, n_steps):
        points[:, i, 0] = lat0
        points[:, i, 1] = lon0
        points[:, i, 2] = dt * i

    # Check inside terrain box for each run at all steps (all same points actually)
    # So just check start point once:
    ok = terrain.inside(lat0, lon0)

    return points, ok
